integrity: The valuation-layer sizes and adjacency criterion are proved directly. Twin classes give the necessary forcing restriction, a largest-white-layer argument proves sufficiency, and an invertible anti-triangular quotient matrix gives the exact minimum-rank witness. The polynomial-root reconstruction is explicit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite commutative chain rings.
The polynomial recovers residue-field order and nilpotency length, not the ring isomorphism type.
Minimum rank is over real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.
The one-vertex parameter pair q=2, ell=2 is a separate boundary case.
title: Zero forcing polynomials and minimum rank of finite chain-ring zero-divisor graphs
